measurementScope: Chromium/SwiftShader CPU-upload and queue-completion proxies. Actual scanout/input-to-photon, unobstructed physical FPS, isolated GPU execution, peak RSS/VRAM and heat/power are unmeasured.
limitations: No physical phone/tablet acceptance or hardware display latency claim.
Proxy completion/cadence is a canvas upload observation; GPU queue completion is a different observation.
Compositor screencast cadence includes capture/delivery overhead.
Geometry raster bases, Seamless/reference and unsupported providers use the exact GPU feedback fallback.
CPU view/history cache rebuilding can temporarily use exact feedback while warming; record replay costs remain bounded per task, not zero.
